svg.title: FIG-12 Documentation, SDK and physical validation boundaries
svg.desc: Exact source, configuration and locked dependencies; cli.py check / test / build Current prose, translations, diagrams and API; Strict bilingual HTML and actual build report Documentation build scope only; package_source_sdk.py Complete prefix, dependencies and licenses; verify_consumers.py Independent configure, build, execution or linking; Actual ARM image and configuration identity; HIL tooling and an actual station PCB, probe, serial and power; Physical results require actual flashing and measurement Equipment unavailable: not_executed; Retain actual commands, exit codes and reports separately No automatic deployment, candidate sealing or product release; Documentation inputs; Actual build; Selected source closure; Consume after integrity verification; Actually linked image; Same image and configuration; Requires equipment execution; Documentation record; SDK consumer record; Physical record
